mu_name_from: OpenMU Version075 Items/Weapons.cs:122 names group 2, index 6 the Chaos Dragon Axe; _enum.h:1544 MODEL_CHAOS_DRAGON_AXE = MODEL_MACE + 6, loaded from Item/Mace07.bmd, and mu.db's row (code 1030) agrees.
why_this_one: The Chaos Machine's Chaos Weapon recipe makes one of the three Chaos weapons (MixMgr.cpp:689, :1002); none of them drops (dropsFromMonsters false in the call), so without a mesh the recipe had nothing to make (2026-10-02).
stance_from: ZzzCharacter.cpp:356-368: a sword, axe or mace that is TwoHand (width 2) stands PLAYER_STOP_TWO_HAND_SWORD.
two_handed_from: Width 2 in the call; OpenMU's `group < Bows && width == 2` and MuMain's ItemAttribute TwoHand agree.
sheet_from: Data/Item/ft6.OZJ (64x128: polished silver-white blades edged in red, gold scrollwork and red studs) on 98 triangles, ft72.OZJ (64x32, a red flame on black) on 12. Decoded from MuMain with pipeline/decode_texture.py.
material_overrides_note: As the Crystal Morning Star's and the Flail's: steel's own 0.2 mirrors the ground.
glow_note: `case MODEL_CHAOS_DRAGON_AXE`: BlendMesh 1, BlendMeshLight = sin(WorldTime*0.004)*0.3+0.7 (ZzzObject.cpp:5263-5266) -- texture 1, ft72's red flame, is drawn added and breathes. Drawn added on its raw sheet (export_gltf.glow_material). ZzzOpenData.cpp:1248 sets Meshs[1].NoneBlendMesh, which only keeps the chrome of a levelled item off that mesh (ZzzBMD.cpp:1425). Not here: the red BITMAP_SHINY+1 sprites MU hangs along the haft when held (ZzzCharacter.cpp:10431-10445) and the red swing blur it shares with the Double Blade (ZzzCharacter.cpp:3951) are client effects. The flame's two bones (Box01, Box03) drift ~5 units through MU's 13-key action 0; held items are rigid here, so it is built at key 0.
no_chrome_from: ZzzOpenData.cpp:1248: Meshs[1].NoneBlendMesh, so a +7 or +9 axe's chrome and metal passes (ZzzBMD.cpp:1425) stay off the flame.
rig_note: No .rig.json, as on Staff06: Mace07.bmd's nine bones include a Mesh01, which the player's skeleton also has at the hand, and a borrowed bind pose would skin the head to it. The .obj is MU's geometry at action 0 key 0, which is all a rigid weapon needs.
material_note: The body (98 triangles on ft6) is polished silver-white blades with red edges and gold scrollwork -- steel, the metal being most of it. The flame's 12 triangles are the glow part and wear no material here; their island rows keep steel for the bake only.
